record: public index of first-party Dota 2 client evidence held privately outside this repository
why_this_file_exists: Raw client captures are load-bearing evidence for this project and are also personally identifying: they show the operator's Steam persona, a friend's display name, avatars, the friend leaderboard and account point totals. None of that is evidence for anything this repository claims. So the raw bytes stay in a private archive and the public repository publishes the sha256 of each original plus a transcription of only the facts the project actually uses. The hash is a commitment: it pins exactly which bytes were read, so a later reviewer can be handed the private file and verify it is the one that was transcribed, without the image ever being published.
private_archive_layout: <private evidence root>/ti2026/{pre_event,post_event}/ plus manifest.private.json. The absolute location is deliberately not recorded here; it is an operator-local path.
repository_local_ingress: evidence_local/ is git-ignored and exists as a staging area for new private captures before they are moved to the private archive. Nothing in it is ever committed.
trust_boundary: Transcription from image to text is done by human-reviewed reading, not by runtime OCR. The hash proves the image has not changed since it was read; it does not prove the reading was correct. Any future change to an image invalidates its record until it is re-read.

evidence.reason_not_committed: the uncropped frame shows the operator's Steam persona, a friend's display name, the friend leaderboard, avatars and account points/percentile
evidence.production_use: the privacy-preserving crop derived from this original (ti2026-ev-002) is the hash-gated seeded-participant evidence consumed by ti_predict/seating_evidence.py

main_event_prediction_settlement.track: Main Event bracket predictions (client tab: International Invitational)
main_event_prediction_settlement.official_points_basis: the client displays the 8/14 count for this track but shows no points figure for it. The 4320 points quoted throughout this project is DERIVED: it is entry 8 of the committed 15-entry Main Event scoring vector in data/ti2026/inputs/prediction_questions.json. It is not a transcription of anything visible in the capture.
main_event_prediction_settlement.per_node_credit_basis: the capture renders the full 14-node bracket with the operator's submitted pick highlighted at every node and marked by the client with a green check or a red cross. Node identity is established by matching each rendered block against the predicted_matchup recorded in the frozen pre-event artifact, which agrees at all 14 nodes.
main_event_prediction_settlement.display_semantics: the client renders the operator's PREDICTED path at every node, not the realized participants. Downstream blocks therefore show teams that did not play there. The check/cross mark is settlement against the realized node winner, which is why a pick can be marked wrong at a node its team never reached.

group_stage_prediction_settlement.note: recorded for completeness; the group slate is a separate tracked production artifact. Its pre-event expectation was 5.249 correct.

public_safe_transcription.deliberately_not_transcribed: the account's overall event point total and percentile, the friend leaderboard and all display names and avatars. The overall point total is NOT a Main Event prediction score and NOT a Fantasy score, and must never be read as either.

excluded_from_this_file: absolute filesystem paths to the private archive
